neighbours.label: The slot just before a verb of placing or installing something (a plaque was, signs will be, surgery to)
fire: A brass marker was fixed to the wall of the old inn.
Warning notices will be displayed at every exit of the park.
Security cameras were mounted above the doors of the bank.
A stone tablet was set into the floor of the chapel.
Dozens of banners would be hung along the main road.
The doctor made a small cut to insert a drainage tube.
Traffic cones were laid out along the edge of the road.
Small flags will be planted beside each grave in May.
quiet: The old innkeeper was proud of the view from the wall.
Ticket prices will be higher at every gate of the park.
Bank managers were worried about the doors of the vault.
The elderly priest was asleep on the floor of the chapel.
Dozens of residents would be angry about the main road.
The doctor made a small joke to calm the anxious boy.
Traffic officers were tired after a long shift on the road.
My cousins will be happy to visit the grave in May.

notes: Output promotes place, placed, placing, placement. Peaks on the auxiliary before the verb, so the subject sets it up: a sign or plaque fires whatever verb follows, while a mayor or the weather stays quiet.
